# Prestige Enterprises

> Official property website for Prestige Enterprises, focused on residential and commercial property enquiries in Kalyan, Maharashtra.

The website publishes property information for Kalyan, details about the Prestige Gold project, and general buyer education. Public pages are available in English, Hindi and Marathi. Use the linked page as the source of truth for the latest published information.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/): Overview of Prestige Enterprises, property configurations, published listing information and enquiry options.
- [Properties in Kalyan](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/areas/kalyan/): Public property information focused on Kalyan, Maharashtra.
- [Areas directory](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/areas/): Main directory for location-related website content.
- [Prestige Gold project](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/projects/prestige-gold/): Project overview, residential configurations, floor-plan information and site-visit enquiries. The page publishes MahaRERA registration number P51700052362.
- [Buyer guides](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/): Educational articles about property purchase, due diligence, home loans and ownership in Maharashtra.

## Buying and property guides

- [How to Buy a Flat in Kalyan–Dombivli](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/how-to-buy-a-flat-in-kalyan-dombivli/): Buyer journey, shortlisting, due diligence, registration and possession.
- [Stamp Duty and Registration Charges in Maharashtra](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/stamp-duty-registration-charges-maharashtra/): Overview of property transaction charges and the need to verify current local rates.
- [How to Check RERA Registration Before You Buy](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/check-rera-registration-before-you-buy/): MahaRERA project checks and due-diligence points.
- [Home Loan Eligibility and EMI Guide](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/home-loan-eligibility-emi-guide/): Income, existing obligations, loan eligibility and EMI planning.
- [Under-Construction vs Ready-to-Move Flats](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/under-construction-vs-ready-to-move/): Practical comparison of delivery, payment and possession considerations.
- [Documents to Check Before Buying Property](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/documents-to-check-before-buying-property/): Title, approvals, property records and document review.
- [Buying a Resale Flat in Maharashtra](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/buying-a-resale-flat-checklist/): Resale due diligence, society records, dues and building checks.
- [Ready Reckoner Rate Explained](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/ready-reckoner-rate-explained/): What the Ready Reckoner rate is and why it matters during a property transaction.
- [Rent or Buy in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/rent-or-buy-in-mumbai-metropolitan-region/): Factors to compare when deciding whether to rent or purchase.
- [Capital Gains Tax When Selling Property in India](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/capital-gains-tax-on-property-sale/): General overview of capital-gains considerations for property sellers.
- [Investing in the Kalyan Corridor](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/property-investment-kalyan-corridor/): Local infrastructure, market considerations and property-investment risks.
- [NRIs Buying Property in Maharashtra](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/nri-buying-property-in-maharashtra/): General purchase-process and regulatory considerations for NRI and OCI buyers.

## Important information and content scope

- Published prices, areas, configurations, project details and availability are subject to change. They are not a guarantee of current inventory or a substitute for a unit-specific written offer.
- Before booking, buyers should confirm current availability, the applicable RERA carpet area, total price, taxes, statutory charges and inclusions directly with the project team in a dated cost sheet.
- Buyer guides are general educational information, not legal, tax, financial or investment advice. Verify current rules with the relevant official authority and qualified professionals.
- Do not infer that an advertised configuration or property is currently available merely because it appears on a website page.
